free_tier.stated: USD 10 one-time credit with no card to start, with 2 sandboxes running at once; a 7-day Pro trial needs no card. Stopped sandboxes cost nothing for compute and storage is free for the first 48 hours of every sandbox.
free_tier.notes: A personal workspace gets the USD 10 from sign-up; a team workspace starts with USD 0 and gets its credit when its first card is saved. Storage after 48 hours is USD 0.10 per GB-month of disk size.

per_object_cap.stated: The small sandbox has 50 GB of disk, medium 50 GB, large 110 GB and xlarge 250 GB; no larger published disk size exists.

retention.stated: Storage is free for the first 48 hours of every sandbox, then USD 0.10 per GB-month until the sandbox is deleted; stopping a sandbox ends its compute charge but not its storage charge. A sandbox with no card and zero credit has its running sandboxes stopped within about 15 minutes.

egress.terms: The docs describe outbound network use and a private mesh with security groups, but publish no egress allowance or per-GB price. The homepage states 'Egress and AI keys: $0'.

interface_detail: A zode CLI and SDK plus a REST API with a GET /v1/usage endpoint; MCP sandbox_create is documented, and an AI chat agent runs in the sandbox. A Linux desktop is available on paid plans and fails with plan_required on Free.
tooling: zode CLI with new, cost and sandbox commands; SDKs; REST API; MCP server.
chaining: Sandboxes run on the same machines as Zode CI and can be forked and snapshotted; a workspace can cap daily spend, and AI provider keys stay on the user's own accounts with no markup.

limits.value: USD 10 one-time free credit on sign-up, plus 2 sandboxes running at once on Free
USD 0.00875 per vCPU-hour; USD 0.0175 an hour for 2 vCPU / 4 GB
USD 0.10 per GB-month of disk size from 48 hours after create

limits_note: Free plan ceiling is medium for automatic sizing and 3 custom images kept; the desktop needs Pro. A workspace daily cap can refuse creates, forks and starts with daily_cap_reached, and no-card workspaces with zero credit cannot create after credit runs out.
binding_note: The one-time USD 10 credit is what runs out first: at USD 0.0175 an hour it is 571 hours of a small sandbox, before the 2-at-once concurrency limit or the storage charge after 48 hours.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: no captured or fresh first-party page names the sign-up or sign-in method; the CLI quickstart says only 'zode login opens your browser and prints a code' and the console renders only its page metadata, so the exact registration fields are unverified: behind a sign-up. A personal workspace starts with USD 10 and no card; adding a card is needed to continue past zero credit. The terms set an 18-year minimum age but name no phone or ID document.

reliability_note: A workspace with no card and zero credit has running sandboxes stopped within about 15 minutes; after the 48-hour storage grace period a deleted or stopped sandbox still incurs storage charges until deletion. The service is in early access and features, limits and prices may change. No page read states the registration identity.
confidence_note: The rate card, free credit, storage rule, plan limits and account behaviour were read from the first-party docs pricing page today. No page read states the sign-in method, so identity_cost.kind is a defaulted placeholder with an unverified detail; the signup form was not readable.
